name: Plumbers
seoTitle: AI Website Audit for Plumbers — Free Website Health Check
metaDescription: Free AI website audit built for plumbers. Find out why your site isn't winning more emergency callouts and installation jobs — in under 30 seconds.
intro: A burst pipe doesn't wait for business hours, and neither do the searches that follow it. Plumbers live or die on how fast a stressed, phone-in-hand visitor can tell you're available, local, and reliable — everything else on the page is secondary to that first five seconds.
painPoints: No emergency/24-hour availability messaging above the fold, so panicked searchers can't tell at a glance whether you'll actually pick up right now
Missing Gas Safe Register number or plumbing-specific certifications, leaving visitors unable to verify you're qualified for gas or boiler work
Contact form asking for excessive detail before a phone number is even offered, adding friction exactly when speed matters most
No structured data marking up service areas, so the site struggles to appear for "emergency plumber near me" searches outside the core town
whyItMatters: Plumbing enquiries split into two very different buyers — emergency callouts (fast, trust-driven, mobile) and planned installations like bathrooms or boilers (considered, desktop-heavy, comparison-shopped). A site built for only one of these loses the other; the strongest plumber websites make the emergency path instant while still building enough trust and portfolio depth to win the bigger planned jobs.

faq.question: Should my plumbing website have a separate emergency page?
faq.answer: Yes — a dedicated, fast-loading emergency callout page with your phone number prominent and availability stated clearly converts far better than making a panicked visitor hunt through a general services page.

faq.question: Does showing my Gas Safe number actually affect conversions?
faq.answer: Significantly — for anything gas-related, customers are specifically taught to check for it, and a visible registration number is one of the fastest trust signals you can display, alongside genuine reviews.

faq.question: How many service area pages should a plumber have?
faq.answer: One dedicated page per distinct town or postcode area you genuinely serve is the standard approach — it gives Google unique, indexable content for each area rather than relying on one generic "areas we cover" list.
